title: HardEval: An Execution-Verified Benchmark for AI-Driven Security Hardening and Compliance Remediation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Implementing Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) controls remains a demanding operating-system administration task. Each natural-language security requirement must be translated into a precise and persistent configuration change. These changes span Secure Shell (SSH) configuration, authentication policy, audit rules, and kernel parameters. Existing benchmarks do not measure whether a model can perform this task on a live system. Code benchmarks evaluate isolated programs without persistent system state, while agent benchmarks largely focus on applications rather than operating-system configuration. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{HardEval}, an execution-verified benchmark for evaluating language-model-assisted security hardening. translated_title: HardEval：一个面向AI驱动安全加固与合规修复的执行验证基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.23685v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：实施安全技术实施指南（STIG）控制项仍然是一项难度很高的操作系统管理任务。每一条以自然语言表述的安全需求都必须被转化为精确且持久的配置更改，这些更改涉及安全外壳协议（SSH）配置、身份验证策略、审计规则以及内核参数。现有的基准测试无法衡量模型能否在真实运行的系统上完成这项任务：代码基准测试评估的是缺乏持久系统状态的孤立程序，而智能体基准测试则主要聚焦于应用程序而非操作系统配置。在本文中，我们提出了HardEval，一个用于评估语言模型辅助安全加固能力的执行验证基准。HardEval基于在未加固的基线系统上无法通过的红帽企业Linux 8（RHEL 8）STIG控制项构建，包含专家撰写的参考修复方案以及开放漏洞与评估语言（OVAL）……
tldr: 提出了HardEval——一个基于RHEL 8 STIG控制项、通过在真实系统上执行验证的方式，来评估大语言模型能否完成操作系统安全加固与合规修复任务的基准测试。
en_tdlr: Introduces HardEval, an execution-verified benchmark built from RHEL 8 STIG controls that evaluates whether language models can perform security hardening and compliance remediation on live operating systems.
